item.title: Google Gemini 3.7 Flash 主打编程与智能体，入门价直降 50%
item.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new version of its workhorse AI model that puts coding, agentic workflows and knowledge work at the center of the upgrade — while temporarily cutting API prices in half.
